definitions.explanation: A device for making audio recordings. Historically referred to tape and reel-to-reel machines; today the word is still used generically for audio recorders, though in casual conversation about handheld digital recorders speakers usually say ボイスレコーダー or ICレコーダー instead.

examples.japanese: {録音機|ろくおんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦オン→オン：29843_on⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{録音機|ろくおんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My father has been using an old recorder for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{録音機|ろくおんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録|きろく}して→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I recorded the contents of the meeting on an audio recorder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{録音機|ろくおんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧1{台|だい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だ。
examples.english: In the past we used big tape recorders, but today a single smartphone is enough.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧ (sound recording) and the suffix -⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, device). The native Sino-Japanese term for a sound-recording device, contrasting with the katakana loanword ⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧.

USAGE:
In writing and more formal contexts, {録音機|ろくおんき} is often preferred, particularly when discussing audio recording in general terms or historical equipment. In everyday spoken Japanese, the more specific loanwords ボイス⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧ or IC⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧ are more common when referring to modern handheld digital recorders. {録音機|ろくおんき} can sound slightly old-fashioned when used for very current consumer devices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {録音機|ろくおんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a recorder
- {録音機|ろくおんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to operate / run a recorder
- {録音機|ろくおんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{録音|ろくおん}する→録音する：25388_rokuonsuru⟧: to make a recording on a recorder
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{録音機|ろくおんき}: a small / compact recorder
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧{録音機|ろくおんき}: a portable recorder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧: recorder — the katakana loanword; covers both audio and video recorders, and is the more common everyday term for modern devices
- ボイス⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧: voice recorder — a handheld audio recorder for speech (interviews, notes)
- IC⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧: IC recorder; digital voice recorder — the solid-state successor to cassette voice recorders; often overlaps with ボイス⟦レコーダー→レコーダー：23720_rekoodaa⟧
- ⟦テープレコーダー→テープレコーダー：03099_teepurekoodaa⟧: tape recorder — specifically a cassette tape recorder
- {録画機|ろくがき}: video recorder — parallel formation with {画|が} (image) instead of {音|おん} (sound)
